entries.arabicExpression: ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِهِمْ وَيَمُدُّهُمْ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: reciprocalHumanSoundingVerbs. The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.originalEnglish: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy.
entries.proposedMeaning: Allah requites their mockery, leaving them to wander blindly in their defiance.

entries.arabicExpression: أَوْ كَصَيِّبٍ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فِيهِ ظُلُمَٰتٌ وَرَعْدٌ وَبَرْقٌ يَجْعَلُونَ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِم مِّنَ ٱلصَّوَٰعِقِ حَذَرَ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَٱللَّهُ مُحِيطٌۢ بِٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineEncompassing. The Arabic muhīt is rendered through Allah's knowledge and power, not as bodily or spatial surrounding.
entries.originalEnglish: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence).
entries.proposedMeaning: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein are darkness, thunder and lightning. They thrust their fingers into their ears at the thunderclaps, fearing death; yet Allah's knowledge and power encompass the disbelievers.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: istiwaIla. Istiwa ila here is rendered without movement, place or direction; the wording expresses the divine ordering of the heavens.
entries.originalEnglish: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things.
entries.proposedMeaning: He is the One Who created for you all that is on earth; then He directed His will to the heaven and fashioned it into seven heavens. He knows all things.

entries.arabicExpression: وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَشْرِقُ وَٱلْمَغْرِبُ فَأَيْنَمَا تُوَلُّوا۟ فَثَمَّ وَجْهُ ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineWajh. The supplied guide reports Mujahid's explanation of wajh in this verse as qiblah, in the context of voluntary prayer while travelling. SalahOS does not render the expression as a bodily face of Allah.
entries.originalEnglish: Unto Allah belong the East and the West, and whithersoever ye turn, there is Allah's Countenance. Lo! Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.
entries.proposedMeaning: To Allah belong the east and the west; wherever you turn, there is the qiblah appointed by Allah. Surely Allah is All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.

entries.arabicExpression: وَإِذْ جَعَلْنَا ٱلْبَيْتَ مَثَابَةً لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمْنًا وَٱتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن مَّقَامِ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ مُصَلًّى وَعَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِـۧمَ وَإِسْمَٰعِيلَ أَن طَهِّرَا بَيْتِىَ لِلطَّآئِفِينَ وَٱلْعَٰكِفِينَ وَٱلرُّكَّعِ ٱلسُّجُودِ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: guideContextExamples. The supplied guide explicitly rejects reading 'My House' as Allah's residence. It gives the meaning that the Ka'bah is a house of great honour to Allah.
entries.originalEnglish: And when We made the House (at Makka) a resort for mankind and sanctuary, (saying): Take as your place of worship the place where Abraham stood (to pray). And We imposed a duty upon Abraham and Ishmael, (saying): Purify My house for those who go around and those who meditate therein and those who bow down and prostrate themselves (in worship).
entries.proposedMeaning: And when We made the House, the Ka'bah, a house greatly honoured by Allah, a place of return for people and a place of safety: take the station of Ibrahim as a place of prayer. We commanded Ibrahim and Ismail: Purify My House for those who perform tawaf, remain there in worship, bow and prostrate.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineColorIdiom. The supplied guide explicitly rejects attributing created sensuous qualities such as colour to Allah. The Arabic sibghat Allah is therefore rendered contextually as the religion/way of faith ordained by Allah, not a physical colour.
entries.originalEnglish: (We take our) colour from Allah, and who is better than Allah at colouring. We are His worshippers.
entries.proposedMeaning: Take on the religion ordained by Allah—and who can ordain a better way of faith than Allah? We worship Him alone.

entries.arabicExpression: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineNearness. Divine nearness is rendered non-spatially through knowledge and response.
entries.originalEnglish: And when My servants question thee concerning Me, then surely I am nigh. I answer the prayer of the suppliant when he crieth unto Me. So let them hear My call and let them trust in Me, in order that they may be led aright.
entries.proposedMeaning: When My servants ask you about Me, I am near to them by My knowledge and response: I answer the call of the caller when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me and believe in Me so that they may be rightly guided.

entries.originalEnglish: The forbidden month for the forbidden month, and forbidden things in retaliation. And one who attacketh you, attack him in like manner as he attacked you. Observe your duty to Allah, and know that Allah is with those who ward off (evil).
entries.proposedMeaning: The sacred month is for the sacred month, and violations are subject to just retaliation. Whoever attacks you, respond in proportion to the attack against you. Be mindful of Allah and know that Allah supports those who are mindful of Him.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: comingAndMovementLanguage. The guide rejects movement of Allah from place to place; the coming is rendered as the coming of divine judgment.
entries.originalEnglish: Wait they for naught else than that Allah should come unto them in the shadows of the clouds with the angels? Then the case would be already judged. All cases go back to Allah (for judgment).
entries.proposedMeaning: Are they waiting for anything except that Allah's judgment should come to them in canopies of cloud, with the angels, and the matter be decided? To Allah all matters return.

entries.proposedMeaning: Who is it that will make a goodly expenditure for Allah's sake, so He may multiply it for him many times over? Allah restricts and expands provision, and to Him you will be returned.

entries.arabicExpression: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا مِّنْهُمْ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةً كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineMaiyyah. The concluding ma'iyyah is rendered as support.
entries.originalEnglish: And when Saul set out with the army, he said: Lo! Allah will try you by (the ordeal of) a river. Whosoever therefore drinketh thereof he is not of me, and whosoever tasteth it not he is of me, save him who taketh (thereof) in the hollow of his hand. But they drank thereof, all save a few of them. And after he had crossed (the river), he and those who believed with him, they said: We have no power this day against Goliath and his hosts. But those who knew that they would meet Allah exclaimed: How many a little company hath overcome a mighty host by Allah's leave! Allah is with the steadfast.
entries.proposedMeaning: When Talut set out with the army, he said: Allah will test you with a river. Whoever drinks from it is not of me, while whoever does not taste it is of me, except one who takes a handful. Yet they drank from it except a few. When he and the believers with him crossed it, they said: We have no strength today against Jalut and his forces. Those certain of meeting Allah said: How many a small group has overcome a large group by Allah's permission. Allah supports the steadfast.

entries.arabicExpression: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: kursi. Kursi is retained as the Qur'anic term rather than translated as a throne or seat that could suggest a place occupied by Allah. The wording is governed by tanzih and does not assign bodily seating, containment or location.
entries.originalEnglish: Allah! There is no deity save Him, the Alive, the Eternal. Neither slumber nor sleep overtaketh Him. Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth. Who is he that intercedeth with Him save by His leave? He knoweth that which is in front of them and that which is behind them, while they encompass nothing of His knowledge save what He will. His throne includeth the heavens and the earth, and He is never weary of preserving them. He is the Sublime, the Tremendous.
entries.proposedMeaning: Allah—there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Sustaining. Neither drowsiness nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursi encompasses the heavens and the earth, and preserving them does not weary Him. He is the Most High, the Magnificent.

entries.arabicExpression: لَّيْسَ عَلَيْكَ هُدَىٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلِأَنفُسِكُمْ وَمَا تُنفِقُونَ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ يُوَفَّ إِلَيْكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تُظْلَمُونَ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineWajh. Wajh Allah in the devotional idiom is rendered without a bodily face.
entries.originalEnglish: The guiding of them is not thy duty (O Muhammad), but Allah guideth whom He will. And whatsoever good thing ye spend, it is for yourselves, when ye spend not save in search of Allah's Countenance; and whatsoever good thing ye spend, it will be repaid to you in full, and ye will not be wronged.
entries.proposedMeaning: Their guidance is not your responsibility; Allah guides whom He wills. Whatever good you spend is for your own benefit, when you spend only seeking Allah's acceptance. Whatever good you spend will be repaid to you in full, and you will not be wronged.

entries.arabicExpression: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَٰبِهَٰتٌ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
entries.context: This is the governing Muhkam/Mutashabih methodology verse in the supplied guide. The SalahOS policy reads all ambiguous divine-attribute wording through the clear tanzih foundations and does not permit a created or bodily meaning for Allah.
entries.originalEnglish: He it is Who hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture wherein are clear revelations - they are the substance of the Book - and others (which are) allegorical. But those in whose hearts is doubt pursue, forsooth, that which is allegorical seeking (to cause) dissension by seeking to explain it. None knoweth its explanation save Allah. And those who are of sound instruction say: We believe therein; the whole is from our Lord; but only men of understanding really heed.
entries.proposedMeaning: He is the One Who sent down to you the Book. In it are clear verses, which are the foundation of the Book, and others that are mutashabih. As for those whose hearts incline to deviation, they follow what is mutashabih, seeking discord and seeking unbefitting interpretations. No one knows their true meanings except Allah and those firmly rooted in knowledge. They say: We believe in it; all of it is from our Lord. Only people of understanding take heed.

entries.arabicExpression: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineYadAndPowerLanguage. Bi-yadika is rendered as power and disposal, not a bodily hand.
entries.originalEnglish: Say: O Allah! Owner of Sovereignty! Thou givest sovereignty unto whom Thou wilt, and Thou withdrawest sovereignty from whom Thou wilt. Thou exaltest whom Thou wilt, and Thou abasest whom Thou wilt. In Thy hand is the good. Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.
entries.proposedMeaning: Say: O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and take sovereignty from whom You will; You honor whom You will and humble whom You will. All good is in Your power and disposal. Surely You are able to do all things.

entries.originalEnglish: (And remember) when Allah said: O Jesus! Lo! I am gathering thee and causing thee to ascend unto Me, and am cleansing thee of those who disbelieve and am setting those who follow thee above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then unto Me ye will (all) return, and I shall judge between you as to that wherein ye used to differ.
entries.proposedMeaning: When Allah said: O Jesus, I will take you and raise you to a place of honour by My command, purify you from those who disbelieve, and place those who follow you above those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to My judgment you will all return, and I will judge between you concerning that over which you differed.

entries.originalEnglish: When Allah made (His) covenant with the prophets, (He said): Behold that which I have given you of the Scripture and knowledge. And afterward there will come unto you a messenger, confirming that which ye possess. Ye shall believe in him and ye shall help him. He said: Do ye agree, and will ye take up My burden (which I lay upon you) in this (matter)? They answered: We agree. He said: Then bear ye witness. I will be a witness with you.
entries.proposedMeaning: When Allah took the covenant of the prophets, He said: Whatever Scripture and wisdom I give you, then a messenger comes confirming what is with you, you must believe in him and support him. He said: Do you affirm and accept My covenant in this? They said: We affirm. He said: Then bear witness, and I bear witness to it as well.

entries.originalEnglish: O ye who believe! Be ye staunch in justice, witnesses for Allah, even though it be against yourselves or (your) parents or (your) kindred, whether (the case be of) a rich man or a poor man, for Allah is nearer unto both (them ye are). So follow not passion lest ye lapse (from truth) and if ye lapse or fall away, then lo! Allah is ever Informed of what ye do.
entries.proposedMeaning: O believers, stand firmly for justice as witnesses for Allah, even against yourselves, your parents, or close relatives. entries.originalEnglish: O People of the Scripture! Do not exaggerate in your religion nor utter aught concerning Allah save the truth. The Messiah, Jesus son of Mary, was only a messenger of Allah, and His word which He conveyed unto Mary, and a spirit from Him. So believe in Allah and His messengers, and say not "Three" - Cease! (it is) better for you! - Allah is only One Allah. Far is it removed from His Transcendent Majesty that He should have a son. His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And Allah is sufficient as Defender.
entries.proposedMeaning: O People of the Scripture! Do not exaggerate in your religion nor utter aught concerning Allah save the truth. So believe in Allah and His messengers, and say not "Three" - Cease! (it is) better for you! - Allah is only One Allah. Far is it removed from His Transcendent Majesty that He should have a son. His is all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth. And Allah is sufficient as Defender.

entries.originalEnglish: Allah made a covenant of old with the Children of Israel and We raised among them twelve chieftains, and Allah said: Lo! I am with you. If ye establish worship and pay the poor-due, and believe in My messengers and support them, and lend unto Allah a kindly loan, surely I shall remit your sins, and surely I shall bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow. Whoso among you disbelieveth after this will go astray from a plain road.
entries.proposedMeaning: Allah made a covenant with the Children of Israel and raised twelve leaders among them. Allah said: I support you. If you establish prayer, give zakat, believe in My messengers and support them, and make a sincere goodly expenditure for My sake, I will surely erase your sins and admit you into Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Whoever among you disbelieves after that has strayed from the straight way.

entries.originalEnglish: The Jews say: Allah's hand is fettered. Their hands are fettered and they are accursed for saying so. Nay, but both His hands are spread out wide in bounty. He bestoweth as He will. That which hath been revealed unto thee from thy Lord is certain to increase the contumacy and disbelief of many of them, and We have cast among them enmity and hatred till the Day of Resurrection. As often as they light a fire for war, Allah extinguisheth it. Their effort is for corruption in the land, and Allah loveth not corrupters.
entries.proposedMeaning: The Jews said: Allah's generosity is constrained. Their own hands are constrained, and they are condemned for what they said. Rather, His bounty is abundant and unrestricted; He gives as He wills. What has been revealed to you from your Lord will increase many of them in rebellion and disbelief. We cast enmity and hatred among them until the Day of Resurrection. Whenever they kindle a fire for war, Allah extinguishes it. They strive to spread corruption in the land, and Allah does not love corrupters.

Thou, only Thou, art the Knower of Things Hidden?

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: reciprocalHumanSoundingVerbs. The Arabic idiom qatalahumu Allah is not rendered as Allah physically 'fighting' them. SalahOS uses its idiomatic imprecatory sense, avoiding a bodily-combat reading.
entries.originalEnglish: And the Jews say: Ezra is the son of Allah, and the Christians say: The Messiah is the son of Allah. That is their saying with their mouths. They imitate the saying of those who disbelieved of old. Allah (Himself) fighteth against them. How perverse are they!
entries.proposedMeaning: The Jews say, 'Ezra is the son of Allah,' and the Christians say, 'The Messiah is the son of Allah.' These are words from their mouths, imitating the words of earlier disbelievers. May Allah destroy them—how far they are turned from the truth!

entries.originalEnglish: Lo! the number of the months with Allah is twelve months by Allah's ordinance in the day that He created the heavens and the earth. Four of them are sacred: that is the right religion. So wrong not yourselves in them. And wage war on all of the idolaters as they are waging war on all of you. And know that Allah is with those who keep their duty (unto Him).
entries.proposedMeaning: Indeed, the number of months with Allah is twelve in Allah's decree from the day He created the heavens and the earth; four are sacred. That is the upright religion. Do not wrong yourselves during them. Fight the polytheists collectively as they fight you collectively, and know that Allah supports those who are mindful of Him.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: divineMaiyyah. The cave statement is rendered as divine support, not co-location.
entries.originalEnglish: If ye help him not, still Allah helped him when those who disbelieve drove him forth, the second of two; when they two were in the cave, when he said unto his comrade: Grieve not. Lo! Allah is with us. Then Allah caused His peace of reassurance to descend upon him and supported him with hosts ye cannot see, and made the word of those who disbelieved the nethermost, while Allah's Word it was that became the uppermost. Allah is Mighty, Wise.
entries.proposedMeaning: If you do not help him, Allah already helped him when the disbelievers drove him out, the second of two, when they were in the cave and he said to his companion: Do not grieve; Allah's support is with us. Then Allah sent His tranquility upon him, strengthened him with forces you could not see, and made the word of the disbelievers lowest, while Allah's word is supreme. Allah is Mighty, Wise.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: reciprocalHumanSoundingVerbs. Nisyan attributed to Allah is rendered as abandonment in recompense, not forgetfulness.
entries.originalEnglish: The hypocrites, both men and women, proceed one from another. They enjoin the wrong, and they forbid the right, and they withhold their hands (from spending for the cause of Allah). They forget Allah, so He hath forgotten them. Lo! the hypocrites, they are the transgressors.
entries.proposedMeaning: The hypocritical men and women are alike: they command what is wrong, forbid what is right and withhold their spending. They neglected Allah, so He abandoned them to their consequences. Surely the hypocrites are the defiantly disobedient.

entries.context: Policy trigger groups: reciprocalHumanSoundingVerbs. The English meaning avoids attributing deficiency, deception, forgetfulness or human-style mockery to Allah; the verb is rendered as a just requital or counteraction appropriate to its context.
entries.originalEnglish: Those who point at such of the believers as give the alms willingly and such as can find naught to give but their endeavours, and deride them - Allah (Himself) derideth them. Theirs will be a painful doom.
entries.proposedMeaning: Those who ridicule the believers who give charity willingly, and those who find nothing to give except their effort—Allah requites their derision. Theirs will be a painful punishment.
